sites.note: bytes 0x143ca54..57: the second byte (0x143ca55) 0 to 1. 0x143ca54 and 0x143ca56 have no reader in the map; 0x143ca57 is read by 0xa06288 and stays 0

summary.effect: function bytes (acm, dnr2, dnr3) = (0,0,0) for every movie request, so CamNrv mode 1: no reference frame, enable register 0xd840 not written, register set of the record at +0x62c
summary.scope: every movie mode until a cold boot, not only the open gate ones; stills requests already use (0,0,0)
summary.when: any time before movie mode is entered: the byte is read at each sequence set-up
summary.not_known: which mode a stock 4K 24p recording uses (the set-up gives mode 6 unless a request field or a per-frame flag says otherwise; a read over USB cannot show it, see build/nr_state.py). If stock already runs mode 1 this changes nothing
